reachable_context_enumeration.reason_for_no_macro_layer: The expanded gate isolates ordinary chained Resolution growth. It does not ask whether the frozen B2 macro helps and cannot be selected using future factorizer behavior.
reachable_context_enumeration.sequence_order: For depth d=1,2,3, enumerate ordered tuples of d distinct variables from the root variable set in lexicographic numeric order.
reachable_context_enumeration.transition_rule: Starting from the source CNF, apply base.eliminate_var_capped sequentially using the unchanged root cap N^2. Abandon a sequence immediately if a pivot is no longer live, the capped elimination returns None, or independent transition replay fails.
reachable_context_enumeration.context_deduplication: Do not use context deduplication to alter first-hit order; every preregistered pivot sequence remains a distinct provenance path even if canonical states coincide.
reachable_context_enumeration.probe_pivot_order: Every variable live in the reached context, ascending numeric order.

diagnostic_next_elimination.definition: Exactly the prior explicit diagnostic: enumerate the complete positive-times-negative resolution product for the probe pivot, omit tautologies, canonicalize and deduplicate exact resolvents, and rebuild untouched union resolvents without cap admission.

no_hit_rule.required: Freeze exact attempts, accepted formulas, OPEN counts, reachable contexts, diagnostic pivots and SHA-256 stream commitments.
no_hit_rule.next: Do not silently weaken the gate. Preregister either a deeper exact-chain search or an adversarial non-training generator before any factorizer implementation.

success_interpretation.future_factorizer_pass: Finite exact representation evidence only; nested operational closure and global polynomial bounds remain separate gates.

next_allowed_code: Only an expanded holdout selector implementing this frozen sampler, exact capped chain traversal, and explicit diagnostic next elimination. No factorized representation code.
